[[File:Radość zespołu Piasta Gliwice.jpg|thumb|250px|Piast Gliwice Polish runners-up celebration in 2016]]

'''Gliwicki Klub Sportowy Piast''' ({{IPA|pol|ɡliˈvit͡skʲi klup spɔrˈtɔvɨ pjazd|pron}}{{efn-ua|In isolation, ''Piast''  is pronounced {{IPA|pl|pjast|}}}}), commonly referred to as '''Piast Gliwice''', is a Polish professional [[association football|football]] club based in [[Gliwice]], [[Silesian Voivodeship]]. Founded in 1945, the club competes in the [[Ekstraklasa]], the top tier of the [[Polish football league system]].

Piast won their first national championship in the [[2018–19 Ekstraklasa]] season and have regularly qualified for European competitions since. Prior to their rise in the 2010s, the club had spent most of its history in the lower divisions.

Piast Gliwice play their home matches at the [[Piotr Wieczorek Municipal Stadium|Piotr Wieczorek Stadium]], a 10,000-seat venue opened in 2011, and traditionally wear blue and red."}}
